svg.title: Checking the EVA study curve against an unused VA35 supplier point
svg.desc: Pressure in kilopascals versus compression from zero to 100 percent, clipped at 1500 kilopascals. The dashed line is the EVA35 study fit. The solid VA35 estimate uses only the supplier anchor of 52 kilopascals at 25 percent compression, marked by a diamond. At 50 percent it predicts 122.6 kilopascals. The unused supplier value, marked by a hollow square, is 118 kilopascals. The prediction is 3.9 percent high. Shading beyond 80 percent marks extrapolation beyond the study range. Both equations diverge at 100 percent. Slow compression only; no impact adjustment or density-based extension.
